steps.en: The gateway reports the payment result and the system records it
steps.id: Gateway melaporkan hasil bayar dan sistem mencatatnya
steps.why_en: A late failure report can overwrite a payment that already succeeded.
steps.why_id: Laporan gagal yang telat dapat menimpa pembayaran yang sudah berhasil.

steps.en: The offender is sent back to the portal with the transaction number
steps.id: Offender dikembalikan ke portal dengan nomor transaksi

steps.en: The page checks the saved result and opens the success or failure view
steps.id: Halaman memeriksa hasil tersimpan dan membuka tampilan sukses atau gagal
steps.why_en: Any status other than success, or a read error, is shown as failed even if the bank charged the offender.
steps.why_id: Status selain sukses, atau gagal baca, ditampilkan sebagai gagal walau bank sudah memotong dana.

steps.en: The page tells the offender the payment was successful
steps.id: Halaman memberi tahu offender bahwa pembayaran berhasil

steps.en: The page tells the offender the payment was unsuccessful
steps.id: Halaman memberi tahu offender bahwa pembayaran tidak berhasil
